how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_066.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|ftbquests|block.ftbquests.chest.inp: Place items here to complete quests
Sneak-right-click to open all in hand
items.lang|ftbquests|item.ftbquests.custom_ico: Right-click on 'Icon' in editor to open custom image selector
items.lang|ftbquests|item.ftbquests.task_scree: Sneak + Right-Click a Task Screen block to bind
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.title: Title
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.icon.tooltip:
Custom icon
Shift-click: select an item texture
Alt-click: select an entity texture
Ctrl-click: select an image texture
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.tags.tooltip: Used for themes and KubeJS events
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.allow_take: Allow to obtain Quest Blocks from the Quests GUI.
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.emergency_: Cooldown timer for emergency items to respawn.
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.defaults.d: Visual preset to be used by all chapters and quests which don't override it
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.loot_crate: Entity Loot Crate Drop Empty Weight
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.pause_game: Does not apply to multiplayer games
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.drop_book_: Drop FTB Quests Book on Death
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.hide_exclu: If false, excluded quests will remain visible but grayed out
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.fallback_l:
The locale used for translations not found in the current locale
This can be overridden on the client via Player Preferences
Defaults to 'en_us' if empty
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.detection_:
Minimum interval (in ticks) between checks of a player's inventory when it changes
Higher values are kinder on server TPS, especially if players inventories change frequently, but mean longer delays for quest auto-completion messages.
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.suppress_a:
If true, no rewards can be autoclaimed, including via the "Claim All" button on the reward selector screen
May be useful during pack development to ensure testers read quests...
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.file.progressio:
Linear: quest must be complete before dependant quests are started
Flexible: tasks in dependant quests can be progressed at any time,
  but dependant quests can't be completed until dependency is completed
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.chapter.appeara: Visual preset to be used by all quests in this chapter which don't override it
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.image.order.too:
Order in which images in the same chapter are drawn.
Higher order images are drawn above lower orders.
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.image.hover.too: You can use literal text or translation keys here
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.image.click_act:
• Open URI: a http://, https:// or file:/// URL
• Jump to a Quest: a quest ID - use 'Copy Quest ID' context menu entry
• Run a Command: command to run on the server
• Post Custom Event: ID argument (namespace:path) for CustomClickEvent listeners
• Show Recipes for Item: item ID
• Show a Docs Page: <mod>,<book-id>[,<page-id>[,<anchor>]]
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.image.position_:
If true, prevents the image from being moved
Useful to prevent accidental movement when other objects overlap
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.image.text.text:
If true, title text (if any) is drawn directly on image
If false, title text is used a tooltip
Horizontal & vertical insets as percentage of image width & height, respectively
items.lang|ftbquests|ftbquests.chapter.appeara: Default Min Opened Quest Window Width
